summary: Iteration 117: Hybrid Referral + Sales Tracking Order Creation Testing. All 14 tests passed. The new order creation system on admin subscription activation is fully functional with correct commission calculation, duplicate prevention, and proper filtering (only paid plans for referred users create orders).

frontend_issues.notes: Backend-only testing as requested. Frontend components (ReferralModal.tsx, ReferralWidget.tsx) not tested.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 117 tested the hybrid referral + sales tracking order creation system. Key findings: (1) Plan config CRUD works - GET returns 3 plans with price/commissionPercent, PUT updates successfully. (2) Order creation on admin activation works correctly - only creates order when: user has referredBy field AND plan is paid (starter/standard/pro). (3) Duplicate prevention works - second activation for same user does NOT create duplicate order. (4) Trial plan does NOT create order. (5) Non-referred users do NOT create order. (6) User schema updated with subscriptionStatus, subscriptionType, plan fields. (7) sales-stats endpoint returns paidCustomers, totalEarnings, pendingEarnings, paidOutEarnings (NO commissionRate field as per requirement). (8) admin/sales-overview returns full data including totalRevenue, totalCommission, partners breakdown. (9) Existing referral endpoints (my-link, stats) still work unchanged.
